column3: “Left unburied” specifies being thrown out; “flow” renders the melting of the mountains.
“Stars” identifies the heavenly host; the Hebrew retains the image of withering.
The final purpose “for judgment” is not explicitly retained.
“Edom’s” names the referent of the feminine possessive.
The second animal is rendered “screech owl”; “the LORD” and “Edom” identify pronoun referents. “A plumb line of destruction” renders stones of emptiness.
“Birds of prey” generalizes the final birds.
“His mouth” replaces “My mouth”; the Spirit is the subject of gathering in the Hebrew.
“Has allotted their portion” renders the casting of a lot; “by measure” renders the measuring line.
